config._n_columns_note: 3x3=9 tru — kich ban minh hoa tuong tac giua cac tru lan can, khong phai toan bo luoi tru thuc te ngoai hien truong

assumed_defaults._warning: Cac gia tri duoi day KHONG co trong SQLite/JSON du an (TCVN 9403 khong quy dinh nu, E dat dap, gamma tru). Dung tri dia ky thuat thong thuong — PHAI ky su xac nhan.

staged_construction._note: GD2..GDN — dap tang dan + lech tam tang dan. q_fraction nhan voi q_kPa cua zone (zones[].q_kPa). eccentricity_m la GIA DINH MINH HOA (mai doc/tai mot ben khi thi cong) — CHUA co khao sat thuc te, PHAI ky su xac nhan truoc khi dung ket qua chuyen vi ngang/mo men. Dieu kien: |eccentricity_m| <= domain_x_m/6 (quy tac loi giua) — ccx_input.py tu canh bao + clamp neu vuot.
